citations.cites: Exclusion E-17 Water damage from a burst or ruptured supply line

facts: Loss occurred at a condo owned by the insured, rented out, vacant for 45 days between tenants.
Water was left on when a supply line burst, causing water damage.
note: The loss involves a burst supply line, which triggers exclusion E-17 unless the discharge is "sudden and accidental" as defined. The adjuster must determine whether the discharge was discovered within 14 days and meets the definition of sudden and accidental. [HO-0304_03-24#05] [HO-0304_03-24#02]
